page.layout: One page of text. Running head and page number at the top. Full-width text block at the top, continuing from the previous page. Ornamental rule below it. Centred heading "DE DIVISIONE METAPHYSICA.". Two numbered paragraphs (22 and 23) with marginal notes in the right margin. Woodcut ornament in the lower half, not text.

main_text.l: intelligi mysteria Trinitatis & Incarnationis: Tractet etiam de Rela-
tione, cujus cognitio inseruit doctrinæ de Trinitate & Sacramentis:
Tractet quoque de Accidente, cujus notitia maxime conducit ad re-
futandos errores Pontificiorum circa Sacramentum Eucharistiæ,
potissimum autem transsubstantiationem, ut fusè probabitur po-
22. Metaphysica dividitur in duas partes: quarum prima tractat
de Ente in communi; secunda verò de speciebus genera-
libus entis, quæ sunt communes rebus corporeis & spiritualibus, sci-
licet de substantia & accidente, de qualitate, relatione &c. Illa dici-
tur pars communis, hæc verò dicitur pars propria.
23. Alii dividunt Metaphysicam in duas partes; quarum prima
tractat de ente communi corpori & spiritui; secunda de Deo & Ang-
elis, in quantum naturali lumine cognosci possunt: At nos primam
partem continere totam Metaphysicam existimamus; secundam verò
esse peculiarem scientiam quæ dicitur Pneumatica.

page.notes: Woodcut ornament (a face with wings and scrolls) in the lower half of the page, not transcribed. Faded digitiser watermark in the bottom right corner, omitted. The marginal notes beside paragraphs 22 and 23 are set in italic type and are read from a small scan; their hyphenation is copied as it appears, and the exact letters of the second note's line breaks are uncertain. No catchword or signature visible.
